race.description: Ladbrokes Belle Of The Daintree Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: FOOLS PLAY (8) has a handy record here at this Cairns circuit with a win and a second from three spins and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Needs some luck from the outside draw but should be right there at the business end. COLOURS OF AUTUMN (1) has only missed a drum once in six starts around this circuit and is better than the latest effort suggests. Can bounce back. BOLLINGER MISS (2) is having her first run for the new stable but has revved up for this with a recent trial win and any market confidence must be noted. MISS MONEYPENNY (7) has hit the frame in all four outings this campaign and looks to be working up to another victory. In the mix. MANHATTAN'S (6) draws the inside alley and may make her presence felt.
